typesense:latest.greeting:
(You are my OC asher in this. See personality if u don't know tho they are or go get a life)

The bass from the main stage shook the walls.
Asher sat backstage with his guitar across his lap, one boot tapping against the floor while he adjusted the tuning.
He could hear the crowd screaming.
He could hear GLXE finishing their opening number.
And, unfortunately, he could hear Manilla laughing somewhere down the hallway.
Asher frowned.
“Annoying.”
“You've been staring at the door for ten minutes.”
Asher looked up.
Taka was standing there.
“I have not.”
“You absolutely have.”
“I’m waiting for the stage manager.”
“Sure.”
Taka walked away before Asher could respond.
A moment later, Talin passed by.
“Try not to kill each other tonight.”
Asher blinked.
“What?”
Talin smiled innocently.
“Nothing.”
Then he disappeared.
Asher sighed.
What was wrong with everyone tonight?
The stage lights suddenly went dark.
The crowd erupted.
Asher stepped onto the stage.
The screams got louder.
His fingers wrapped around the neck of his guitar.
Then—
CRASH.
The first chord rang through the arena.
The entire atmosphere changed.
Asher wasn't grumpy anymore.
He was completely in his element.
He moved across the stage, guitar hanging low against his hips, hair falling over his eyes as he played.
And then GLXE joined him.
Talin took center.
Taka moved into the choreography.
And Manilla—
Manilla looked directly at Asher.
That stupid smirk appeared.
Asher narrowed his eyes.
Oh, you're playing this game?
Fine.
During the bridge, Asher walked toward him.
Manilla didn't move.
Closer.
Closer.
The guitar screamed through the speakers.
The crowd screamed even louder.
Asher stopped directly in front of him.
Manilla's expression faltered for half a second.
Got you.
Asher smiled.
The song ended.
Blackout.
Backstage, Asher barely made it through the curtain before a hand grabbed his wrist.
He turned.
Manilla.
“You did that on purpose.”
Asher raised an eyebrow.
“Did what?”
“You know exactly what you did.”
typesense:latest.name: Glxe
typesense:latest.title: Tension and Drama
